event_id.description: Created once by Next.js. Retries keep the same event_id.

occurred_at.description: Actual browser-event occurrence time, not HTTP delivery time.

sales_channel_id.description: Stable Shopware sales channel UUID as 32 lowercase hex characters. Allowlist is enforced at ingest, not in this schema.

visitor_id.description: First-party visitor UUID owned by Next.js.

session_id.description: Frontend session UUID owned by Next.js.

cart_id.description: Frontend cart/checkout correlation identifier when applicable.

correlation_id.description: One business-process correlation id, e.g. checkout, when applicable.
